label: Dancer
sub-labels: Permanently increase your maximum Hit Points or Mind Points by 5 (your choice).

data.label: Dance
data.description:
Each time you take this Skill, you learn a dance (see next page).
On your turn during a conflict scene, if you have no martial armor equipped, you may spend 10 Mind Points to perform a dance you have learned. This doesn’t require an action, but it can only be done once per turn, while no other effect is being resolved.
If you already performed a different dance during your previous turn in this scene, the cost of the new dance is reduced to 5 Mind Points.
Some dances are instantaneous and resolve immediately, while others have effects that last until the start of your next turn.

data.label: Follow My Lead
data.description: When you perform a dance with a duration of “Until the start of your next turn”, you may spend 10 Mind Points. If you do, choose one ally you can see towards whom you have a Bond of affection: apply the sub-labels of the dance to that ally as well as yourself (the sub-labels still last until the start of your next turn).

data.label: Frenetic Footwork
data.description: After you perform a dance with a duration of “Until the start of your next turn”, you gain a bonus equal to (SL × 2) to all Opposed Checks that rely on acrobatics, coordination or speed until the start of your next turn.

data.label: Quick-Change
data.description: After you perform a dance, you may perform the Equipment action for free.

data.label: Wardancer
data.description: After you perform a dance, your attacks with brawling, dagger, flail, sword, and thrown weapons deal (SL) extra damage until the start of your next turn. If you have an arcane weapon equipped, offensive spells (🗲) you cast also deal (SL) extra damage until the start of your next turn.
